svg.title: Sheet 7 - Event cards 10-18, 63 x 88 mm (A4)
svg.desc: The second half of the Event deck. HERO now keys off the 5 Legs/Pressure-Response options only (Own It/Analyze/Support/Speak Up/Engage), 3 cards per option across the 18-card deck; FALSE START and THE AUDIT have no HERO route at all. THE DATE MOVES UP has no ADAPT cost: only a Speak Up Hero or Authorized Voice cancels it.
